facts.fact: Communications minister Samuel Nartey George said Ghana plans 800 new and 2,000 upgraded cell sites this year, with traditional leaders helping prioritise underserved areas, and he inspected a newly built Rural Telephony Project facility at Akoefe Gadza in the Volta Region.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations
